description: This file implements IDNA2008 domain name processing, including functions for converting domain names to ASCII and Unicode, validation, normalization, and label validation according to RFC standards and Unicode Technical Standards. It defines profiles for different use cases such as lookup, display, and registration, and includes detailed label validation logic.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Represents configuration for IDNA processing, including validation and mapping options.

classes.name: labelError
classes.description: Error type for invalid domain name labels.

methods.name: ToASCII
methods.description: Converts a domain name to its ASCII-compatible form.

methods.name: ToUnicode
methods.description: Converts an ASCII domain name to Unicode form.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string describing the profile configuration.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Implements the core IDNA processing algorithm, including normalization, validation, and encoding.

methods.name: validateLabel
methods.description: Validates individual domain name labels according to RFC rules.

methods.name: simplify
methods.description: Adjusts label categories based on profile options.

methods.name: isBidi
methods.description: Checks if a string has bidirectional properties.

methods.name: validateAndMap
methods.description: Performs validation and mapping of labels, including normalization.
